events.what_it_is: A free immersive bodega-themed pop-up celebrating NYC shop cats, with cat-themed photo moments, games, treats and merchandise prizes.
events.what_is_free: Free public admission, TEMPTATIONS Classic Treats and Lickable Puree samples, plus chances to win Cat Bodega merchandise through games and scratch-offs.
events.caveats: Official TEMPTATIONS/Mars sources call the physical pop-up free and say visitors can stop by; no required ticket or RSVP is stated. Treats and merchandise prizes are subject to availability/chance mechanics.
events.practical_notes: September 17–19, noon–6 PM daily at 213 Bowery. The official source also describes a separate virtual Cat Bodega running September 17–26; this listing covers the NYC physical pop-up only.

events.event_name: Bobbi Brown The Prime Times Newsstand
events.address: Chelsea Triangle, 9th Avenue between 14th and 15th Street, New York, NY 10011
events.what_it_is: A one-day Bobbi Brown newsstand activation celebrating Vitamin Enriched Face Base+, with product sampling, refreshments, scratch-off giveaways and a mirrored photo moment.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary VEFB+ sample, refreshments/croissants and scratch-off giveaway opportunity while supplies last; first 100 guests in line receive a deluxe-size sample.
events.caveats: The organizer's Eventbrite page is a free invitation/ticket page. Samples, refreshments, scratch-off prizes and the first-100 deluxe sample are while supplies last. Event photography/video will be captured for Bobbi Brown digital/social use.
events.practical_notes: Thursday September 17, noon–6 PM at Chelsea Triangle / Meatpacking Plaza. Free RSVP is available through the organizer's Eventbrite listing.

events.event_name: CookUnity: The Most Legendary Lunch Break
events.address: Five Manhattan bodegas: 451 Third Avenue; 266 West 23rd Street; 369 Madison Avenue; 275 West Fourth Street; 873 Broadway, New York, NY
events.what_it_is: A three-hour CookUnity takeover of five Manhattan bodegas where eight chefs serve complimentary signature dishes and guests receive a bodega-style scratch-off.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary CookUnity signature dish while supplies last, with hot bites or cold packaged meals depending on location/availability, plus a scratch-off chance to win additional prizes.
events.caveats: Current sources describe the giveaway as open to anyone who walks into a participating location. Food is while supplies last. No required RSVP/ticket was found in the verified sources.
events.practical_notes: Thursday September 17, 11:30 AM–2:30 PM at Slice n' Spice Deli & Grill (451 Third Ave), Madison Square Deli & Convenience (266 W 23rd St), New York Pizza and Cafe (369 Madison Ave), Sam's Deli (275 W 4th St), and Bari Bodega (873 Broadway).

events.address: Sephora SoHo, 557 Broadway, New York, NY 10012
events.what_it_is: A two-day Medik8 activation at Sephora SoHo with free samples and personalized skincare consultations; September 16 also includes a separately qualified Ariana Madix meet-and-greet.
events.what_is_free: Free samples and personalized skincare consultations. The Ariana Madix meet-and-greet is not generally free-access: the first 150 eligible customers purchasing two or more full-size Medik8 products on September 16 receive qualifying wristbands.
events.caveats: Current event listing says free RSVP is available for each date. The general pop-up offers free samples/consultations, but the September 16 Ariana Madix meet-and-greet requires purchase of at least two full-size Medik8 products and is limited to the first 150 eligible customers; do not present that meet-and-greet as part of the free admission promise.
events.practical_notes: September 16 general pop-up: noon–5:30 PM; Ariana Madix meet-and-greet 6–8 PM for separately qualified wristband holders. September 17: 11 AM–7 PM. Current source provides date-specific free RSVP links but the direct destination was not independently extracted in this pass, so the main source is retained rather than inventing a URL.
